(FAQ)

Questions

Is ad spend included?

No. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta or Google from your account. Our fee covers strategy, creative, setup and management.

How much should I spend on ads?

Enough to get meaningful data in your area, which for most local businesses starts at a few hundred dollars a month. We recommend a starting budget on the strategy call.

What is AI search visibility?

More people ask ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity for recommendations. We structure your site, profile and listings so those assistants can find and recommend you.

Do I have to sign a long contract?

No. Monthly plans are month to month.
